The population of African penguins in Southern Africa is on the decline, but the charismatic species has found a stronghold on two islands in Algoa Bay. This is the story of the penguins’ daily struggle to raise families in an unforgiving and hostile environment.

For the first few weeks of life, the world is a frightening place. Danger lurks around every corner. It pays to be alert. Whether predator or prey. Any day might be your last. The race is on to grow up fast- for even the largest animals are vulnerable to attack.

If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

Travel to western Germany, where Europe’s largest mammals have returned to the landscape after being hunted to extinction in the early 20th century. Discover the challenges animals and humans face from the beasts’ reintroduction to the wild.

Explore a biodiversity hotspot in the heart of northern Germany, where biologists engineered the return of tree frogs, mink, Ferruginous ducks, and osprey. Discover how the area may become a paradise for many rare animals once considered extinct.

Investigate the animals that have been returned to this mosaic of extreme habitats in Spain. Then discover how small environmental changes can make big differences in the populations of many endangered species and give them a real chance to recover.

The Nile crocodile and hippopotamus are two of Africa’s amphibious freshwater icons, found in waterways, rivers and lakes across the continent, including the stunning wilderness of Kwa-Zulu Natal in South Africa. These two species have co-existed for thousands of years, evolving in different ways to a life aquatic.
Growing up in the rainforests in the heart of Colombia, a young capuchin monkey has to master his climbing skills, learn how to find food and learn to distinguish friend from foe.

From Colombia’s high plains of the Páramo to its tropical forests, hummingbirds have evolved into an extraordinary number of species. Whether battling freezing rain or jungle predators, each mother must struggle to build a nest, protect her eggs.

The flat savannas of the Colombian Llanos are governed by seasonal extremes that push life to the brink. In this unforgiving arena, there are no second chances, and only creatures best adapted to their brutal extremes will make it through a year.

Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop. Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.
When Sam and Cat are hired to take a pair of obnoxious kids on a flight to the Bahamas, they must first get through the challenges of the airport.

p.t: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
p.d: The mutant seahorse called MUSTANG SALLY is going to flood the city... and the only thing standing in his way are LEO and Pigeon Pete. Being the leader isn't all it's cracked up to be.

p.t: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
p.d: The East River 3 are on the verge of victory! The Turtles and Mutanimals must team up to stop them, but not everything is as it seems... what is the PEARL and why does Goldfin want it?
SpongeBob meets a magical fish. // SpongeBob cooks in the big leagues.

Lady Upturn introduces Squidward, and his musical 'talents', to her high society friends after she becomes his patron. // Squidward sets out to prove that aliens aren't real...until he has a close encounter of his own.

Bibi goes live, but when she's not getting enough likes Twister steps in to help, and is almost unmasked. // Gran Gran's convinced the Chahuta and won't impress a food critic, so tries to change things.

Bettervale is celebrating 'Better Day' but Best and Bester manage to anger the townsfolk by causing mischief again. // After a period of exile Best and Bester return hoping to patch things up with their neighbours and with each other.

The twins take a cactus called Pricklebutt to the beach and end up mounting a dramatic search and rescue mission. // Best and Bester won't let Grumpy Pants' round of golf stop them from catching the finale of their favourite show.
Patrick and Squidina help the Flim-Flam brothers hunt the ghost that haunts their house. // On her day off from the Patrick Show, Squidina helps Rube produce his TV show.
Patrick hosts a countrified variety show. // The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to get their kicking can back.
Patrick and Squidina go on location to interview their neighbors.

Sonic lands in the deep seas of The No Place, where pirate versions of his friends are led by Knuckled the Dredd. When Sonic's hunt for the No Place Shard runs afoul of the Dredd's haunted past, the crew names a new captain... Sonic!

Chloe, Jinx, and Booch are designing a new school mascot, but Max and Phoebe's fighting ruins the project. After Chloe expresses her anger toward her siblings, they realize their twin-fighting impacts Chloe in new ways now that they're guardians.

Shunsuke Kawamura worked in a real estate company and was always the best of the best when it came to sales. He was going to marry the daughter of the CEO of his company, but then, something unexpected happened...Just before the day of his wedding, he attended a surprise party held by his colleagues and got drunk. On his way home, he accidentally fell into a deep manhole. By the time he woke up, it was already midnight. What was even worse was that his right leg was heavily injured and he could neither contact the police nor find out his current location using GPS. The only person he could contact was his ex-girlfriend, but she did not believe in his words. He started to believe that he might have been set up by someone, so he decided to set up a new Twitter account named “Manhole Girl”, hoping that with the help of the internet, he could locate himself and call out for help. Netizens excitedly assisted him to search for the suspect.

“Another World”, the Hong Kong animation nominated for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival (also known as the Oscars of animation), is a heartfelt seven-year labour of love. In this interview, its screenwriter-producer Polly Yeung and Art director Step C. share the behind-the-scenes stories. Polly recounts her moment of tears on the nomination and the intention of its theme and character design. Step C. also reveals their feeling of frustrations like giving-up that comes along with the challenges of completing this project.

Early spring in the city of Macau. Mada (Louis Cheung), a divorced man in his 40's, is the strong and silent type. He lives in a dilapidated flat that's set for demolition. Suffering from a serious case of amnesia, Mada works the graveyard shift as a taxi driver to overcome the pain of his affliction. One night, Mada picks up Lena (Chrissie Chau), who works as a restaurant receptionist by day and a bar hostess by night. After a misunderstanding sparks spark their friendship, Mada becomes Lena's driver, picking her up before and after work. Lena's arrival finally brings some color into Mada's life; he even begins to think that he can finally move on from his divorce. Yet, Lena feels lonely in Macau; she's disliked by her colleagues, who all think that she is a ruthless, money-grubbing hustler for using her voluptuous figure to get special treatment. Lena knows Mada's feelings for her, but she, too, is hiding a past that she can't get over...

Ji-hye is a once-successful and beautiful swindler, who recently begins failing with her cons and dreams of changing her small-job life. Before her retirement, she decides to take on one last job which could change her whole life: seducing the son of a wealthy art broker family to steal the golden treasure hidden in their secret mansion. With the help of her daughter Ju-young, she succeeds in earning the trust of the family but it turns out to be a never-ending battle. Can Ji-hye and Ju-young find the legendary treasure and start a new life?

It's a romantic comedy between the next door neighbors Lin-lin Chou and Yu-ke Fang, who have totally opposite school performances. While Lin-lin struggles to pass the exams, Yu-ke gets the highest score in every of them. Just when Lin-lin supposes she is finally going to say good-bye to Yu-ke after high school graduation, they get accepted by the same department – department of animal husbandry, the most unpopular department of the most popular university. To fix Yu-ke's “First love trauma” she accidentally caused, Lin-lin tries everything to help him chase back his first love, the queen bee of the school. However, Lin-lin herself also gradually falls for Yu-ke during the process. What should Lin-lin do with her feelings? What is actually going on in Yu-ke's mind? The graduation season is around the corner, this is a story for you to call back your first love memory.
Ace Vampire slayer Reeve and his new partner Gipsy are on this mission, however Reeve's younger sister Helen falls in love with the Vampire fifth prince Kazaf.

April is a beloved 8-year-old daughter of Pij and Ake. Unfortunately, she is kidnapped mysteriously and Pij dedicates her life to finding her missing daughter. One day there is a burnt corpse of a girl and the only thing left is a small piece of fabric that matches April's cloth on the day she disappeared. The DNA result from the fabric proves that it matches 95% of April's DNA. Pij doesn't believe that it is April's corpse and continues searching for her daughter. Pij hires Tan, who used to work for a Missing Children Foundation. Pij has hope again until they meet a psycho man who brutally kidnaps children. The life-threatening struggle to find the truth; therefore, begins...
Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

Three stories, three struggles for survival, strung together in search of happiness. My Heavenly City uses three interconnected stories to explore the hopeful aspirations of new Asian immigrants moving to New York City – the city of their dreams. We follow a lonely young woman moving to the city to work as a Chinese-English translator, a young couple obsessed with hip-hop and parents dealing with a child with mental illness. They unknowingly influence each other as their paths cross, affecting each other in ways as they go about their lives.

The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father...

A group of Korean tourists is taken hostage by an extremist Taliban group in Afghanistan. The Korean government dispatches Jae-ho, known as one of Korea's most skilled diplomats, in order to handle the situation. Once he arrives, he asks for the Afghan government's cooperation and uses every means possible to free the hostages. However, his efforts go in vain. Due to his failure, he's forced to work with Dae-sik, a special agent who is an expert on the Middle East. As they begin making their move to get to the Taliban, the first hostage death occurs. With nowhere else to turn, the two become unlikely allies in a race against time to save the rest of the hostages.

Once a star in his finance firm, Bowen now spends his nights in a 24-hour fast food joint, where he encounters others “roommates” who are in a similar predicament: a mother with her daughter who has taken out high-interest loans to cover her mother-in-law's debt, an old man who is too afraid to go home, a young runaway, a young singer living in a temporary shelter. Together these accidental roommates must strive to lift one another out of rock bottom.
Bodybuilder and striper Biggie can see into people's past lives. He meets rookie cop Yee and help her track down criminals. Yee decides to help him back while Biggie decides to......

Courier Ting delivers a parcel to a mysterious girl, entering a decaying mansion where he is forced to participate in a bizarre ritual: in a dark room, he must press six light switches in time with the burning of six incense sticks. The lights gradually illuminate Mei Xiao, a reclusive qipao seamstress whose face remains hidden. Ting becomes infatuated with her, unaware that he is stepping into the ancient curse of the 'Cloth Spirit'-where his obsession becomes the final stitch in crafting the perfect sacrificial vessel. When the lights dim and the incense burns out, his soul will be forever trapped within the elegant garment, never to find peace.

Every day, the Police Force receives 185 phone calls.180 of them are about burglaries, murders, rapes and kidnappings. The remaining 5 begin with: “There is something strange in my house, can you please send someone over to take a look?” For rookie Sergeant Lee, being a cop means running down crooks and upholding the law. Injured in a shoot-out, he finds out to his horror that he is reassigned to the dubious-sounding Miscellaneous Affairs Department (MAD)...

MA and KAU were the Senior Inspectors of Narcotics Bureau. They were smuggling with the Golden Triangle in Thailand. CHEUNG – an officer of Custom Department. CHEUNG and MA were good friend since they studied in the University. MA's group wanted to get more help in custom, he asked CHEUNG to be his partner, but CHEUNG refused. While KAU was very hasty, he killed all CHEUNG's family. Then, CHEUNG wanted to take revenge against them. However, MA and KAU made a plan to get CHEUNG into trouble. At last, CHEUNG escaped to Thailand and stayed at his aunt's house. MA and KAU knew that CHEUNG escaped to Thailand, so they tried their best to kill him, but they did not succeed...

Since veteran filmmaker Manfred Wong joined the film industry since 1970s and worked for numerous Hong Kong companies at the position from scriptwriter, Head of Promotions to film producer, he has now been the best guide bringing us to travel through a sense of nostalgia for the old days of Hong Kong cinema. In this programme, he tells refinedly that there was a strife between Cantonese and Mandarin movies in 50s and 60s while fierce competitions amongst different film production companies over decades; also how various film companies manifested in the 90s golden era of Hong Kong movies.

Hung Hei Kwun, a kungfu student of Shaolin, is against the Manchu rulers. Hung's whole family was arrested and later beheaded. Hung killed Ning-Erh Ma in revenge and escaped with his youngest son, Man-Ting, to nowhere land. Several years later, Chishan, Father Superior of the Shaolin Temple, found a map to a treasure trove but contents were tattooed on the backs of his five young masters. If missing one master, the trove could not be found...

Tiger, the older brother of Chinese Southern boxing champion Li Fung, was killed by Chow, a boxer of the rival Lung, during a boxing competition. Fung stayed in the boxing gym for handling his brother's funeral. Tiger's apprentice Nan and rogue Yin loved Fung at the same time. When Fung knew Nan fake a match to repay the boxing gym debt, she decided to bet on 300,000 dollars for a match with Chow. In the game, Fung killed Chow. Lung vowed to revenge, and captured Nan to threaten Fung for a final battle...
Lee Rock realizes the promotion is indeed the manoeuvre of his surrender of power. So he decides it is the right time to resign. His son, Yin, has graduated and joins the ICAC....
So, the legendary beggar, is actually born in a princely rich family. Like his father, So leads a lavish life. He once meets Ju Suan and falls in love with the virgin prostitute..

Our story begins in the Hang Seng Sanitarium, which has a quite amount of crazy people. Ah Tim is a handy man there and Li is a nurse. Ah Tim has the greatest enthusiasm in his work, especially when he combs through the remains of the deceased and divests them of worldly items like gold fillings. However, his enterprise is spotted by Li, therefore, he has to make it a profit sharing venture. Later on, with the arrival of old Cheng, big fortune comes too. The two is now planning seriously how to get all the valuables from the big guy. However...

Street boy Qian Jidong had been idolizing Pujun, one of the 'Double Eagles in Mong Kok' since childhood. His father was beaten because he owed Xiyang a loan, so Qian Jidong went to Xiyang desperately, but was captured by Xiyang. At a critical moment, Pujun appeared and saved his life. Then, Qian Jidong worked for Pujun. But Qian Jidong's girlfriend GIGI did not like him working in the underworld and finally broke up with him...
Kwai's brother owed the Fok's family two million and Fok's manager Robert persuaded to merge Fu's company. The three pals joined Fok's to solve the crisis...

“The Banquet” assembled star-studded cast that aimed for charity to support disaster relief efforts at that time. Adapted from the 1959 Cantonese film of the same name and co-directed by Tsui Hark, Clifton Ko, Joe Cheung, and Alfred Cheung, the film tells the story of a greedy couple deceiving their estranged father to secure a huge amount business deal with oil producing country. While they pretend to welcome the father into their home and prepare a birthday banquet for him, rival also throws a competing banquet...With continuous top-star cameos offering countless surprises and laughs, this film remains remarkable, entertaining and meaningful to audience nowadays.

Michele takes off for Europe to contemplate her inevitable divorce. She meets the beautiful Miki, a Japanese model who tries to end a relationship with a married man. There is nothing like love trouble to foster a quick bond and the women become close friends. However, during an evening of drunken revelry, Miki discloses by accident that she is the other woman of Michele's husband...

Dragon and Kan are childhood friends who spend most of their free time chasing after local girls in general and spying on one in particular who catches their eyes. A gang in the nearby dwelling is smuggling precious Chinese artifacts to westerners. Hai Huo is a reluctant party to the scheme and when he voiced his objection, the big boss sent his henchmen after him to keep him quiet. When the mischievous duo came across Hai Huo, who was hiding in their village, they take on the gang to protect the artifacts.
Mac, a professional thief, and three others organize commercial thieves together. While stealing a cancer vaccine, they find a pre-set bomb which it is a setup against them...

Ren takes out his entire savings and persuades his best friend Sing to leave for Vegas with him. They challenge the most well respected dealer in town, and in just one round, Ren's wages is all wiped out. Ren and Sing begin their trip back to LA, but on the way their car mysteriously overturns and crashes, Sing is dead. Ren arrives home wearily to find a message on his answering machine that warns him not to go to Vegas. He decides to go back to Vegas to find out what really happened that killed Sing...
A trio of disturbing short films from 3 top Asian directors makes up this terrifying anthology, 'Dumplings' by Fruit Chan; 'Cut' by Chan-wook Park and 'Box' by Takashi Miike.

改編自青衫取醉的小說《虧成首富從遊戲開始》。大廠打工人裴謙（彭昱暢飾）慘遭辭退之際，意外奇遇神秘大佬的邀請，創辦了一家必須以虧損為目標的公司。於是他集齊各種不靠譜的蝦兵蟹將，開啟了他的「裴」錢計劃，絞盡腦汁地給員工加薪放假發福利，投資了一個個奇葩項目，不料竟次次意外反轉，屢戰屢賺。裴謙成為了員工心中的神仙老闆、 業界公認的商業奇才，卻依舊苦不堪言。裴謙只好嚥下「暴富」的苦，繼續尋找更多「逆風翻盤」的機會。

p.d: 「音樂+旅行+社交」的唱演真人秀，由王赫野、王琳凱、張碧晨三位老友攜手劉雨昕、周震南、姚曉棠、容祖兒等多位新朋友，跟隨「音你小隊」開啟全新的集體旅居生活；音樂人將在絕美的自然風光中尋找創作靈感，通過音樂與當地人產生連接與互動，帶來一場充滿人情味的治療音樂之旅。
22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛？
全明星沉浸式劇情體驗綜藝；圍繞遊戲、喜劇兩大元素，以社會熱點話題為創作基礎，打造不同遊戲主題。一個盒子空間，一群神秘玩家，他們需要在各種離奇、爆笑和反轉中，一步步揭開故事真相，走出盒子，體驗一場專屬的心靈療愈之旅。
腦洞鑑定類綜藝推理脫口秀，陣容為薛之謙、大張偉、楊迪、劉維、黃子弘凡、黃聖依、龐博等…節目圍繞著當下熱梗熱點、觀眾的興趣點、共鳴點展開故事；火星特工廣發英雄帖正面對撞，迎戰近年最出圈、最有趣、最敢說的廠牌大咖們，真金不怕火煉，一場席卷全網的廠牌巔峰之戰即將展開！
大型腦力競技真人秀，以「以省之名，我們一起贏」為slogan，由蔣昌建擔任主持人，攸佳寧、龐博、魏坤琳組成中國戰隊領隊候選人，並由朱丹及黃聖依等組成最強啦啦隊，以創新為魂，團隊為翼，共赴腦力盛宴。
將繼續以「音樂牽線，緣分發聲」為主題，賽制上進行了全面創新升級，帶來更具懸念的緣分匹配設定、更多元的趣味互動模式，以及更動人的團隊默契考驗；匯聚周深、薛之謙、單依純等10位實力歌手與新銳音樂人，通過盲選歌單、即興創作等環碰撞靈感，打造專屬合作舞台！
遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

以「姐姐當家，愛是什麼」為主題，集結杜華、房主任、冉瑩穎、小鹿、徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉、倪萍、倪子君、張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案。
邀請文博愛好者組成「文物代言人」，通過多元形式演繹國寶故事；以舞台創演、文創開發的創新形式，搭建起傳統文化與年輕群體的溝通橋樑，為文化傳承注入青春活力與澎湃動能。
《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。
專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。
節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以「聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌」為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧、毛不易、馬嘉祺、古巨基、李克勤、騰格爾、龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴。

With their travels taking them to Asia, Rooftop and Catfish find themselves spending several dangerous days in Bangladesh. The pair put their bodies and safety to the test harvesting honey the Bangladeshi way, transporting workers via row boat, deconstructing ships for scrap metal, and trying to clean one of the country’s rare public restrooms. They test out Bangladeshi cuisine in the form of fish, cow stomach, and goat brain curry, and race some locals on their rickshaw bikes. The trip concludes with Rooftop and Catfish heading out of town by train- only running across the top. With all of Bangladesh’s physical dangers, can the BMX bikers make it out without a hospital visit?

After being dropped off into the mountains where there were only whispers and tales of mountain monsters being seen. Mario is on the search of the outer limits of the mountains to find himself a monster red deer. His arrow successfully finds a big red and he showcases some recipes he learnt from the southern regions of Italy form leading celebrity chefs. But not before a mammoth carry out through the back country of the Deep South.

Mario teams up with good friend and precision rifle expert Bernard and heads into the high alpine mountains above New Zealnd’s rugged West Coast in search of tahr. Drawing on his Greek roots, Mario cooks a rustic “Kleftiko” dish in an earth oven.

在最重視了解自然災害和吉凶的日本有著世界上最古老的調查機構「全領域異常解決辦公室」以解決難以想像的「無法解釋的異常案件」。但似乎隱藏著一個巨大的秘密. .....人們面對的「異常事件」，例如無法用科學解釋的超自然現象。這是一個可能真實發生在你身邊的故事。甚麼是真實的，甚麼是虛構的？ 真相在下一刻就變成了妄想。

超市每天都有可能因需求不足而產生剩餘食材。為了解決此問題，它們設有專門的回收單位，負責妥善回收這些食材，確保它們得到合理利用。將剩餘食材轉交俾其他機橋進行「升級再造」，由收集食材、分類、處理，最終製作成新的食物產品，供給有需要的人士或團體。從減少食物浪費，同時體現企業的社會責任，促進環保和社區發展。
台灣是全世界高山密度最高的島嶼之一，亦是一個自然環境跟文化豐盛的地方，無論是休閒遊、深度遊、吃喝玩樂之旅皆十分適合。節目將由台北走到台中，遊走各大名山勝景，帶觀眾看遍台灣好風景。遊走台灣陽明山、合歡山、鳳凰谷山麓、谷關、太平山，看出不一樣的台灣面貌。以四大潮山玩法為中心，探索只有當地人才知道的獨有行山體驗。
第一位女嘉賓是充滿 gfable 氣息的女神。「gfable」是港式英語 Girl Friend-able，意即「適合做女友」，專門形容一些令男生很有衝動想「和你在一起」的女孩子。初次見面的環節，與女神的對談已讓 Marco 很想和她一起⋯⋯約會。然後得到神隊友——約會軍師 193 的協助，一同按著女神的喜好制定 TailorMade 的約會活動！究竟這集 Marco 能否得到女神的青睞嗎？
中風是一個突發性而且足以致命的疾病，但又是否無跡可尋？究竟中風會有那些預兆病徵？雖然中風難以預防，但主人若及早留意到病徵，對狗狗的情況會有莫大幫助。而同時作為馴犬師的嘉賓 Anton 亦分享了訓練狗狗腦部活動的方法。
今集主持阿神繼續訪問奶茶師傅Howie，介紹香港的奶茶課程。另外，阿神亦會嘗試製作西多士，進一步體驗茶餐廳文化！
King，衝浪運動員，正職為電單車速遞員，同時兼任足球教練。他每日穿梭街頭送件，又帶領足球訓練，工作結束後仍趕往室內衝浪場，挑戰浪板平衡與浪花節奏。室內衝浪在香港屬新興小眾運動，講求核心穩定、反應速度與對浪的感覺。King 多年來堅持練習，積極參與本地體驗賽及推廣活動，以熱血態度推廣這項充滿刺激的水上運動。
相信很多人也有聽過「電競」，但你又知道這項運動也需要教練嗎？今集，就邀來電競教練兼足球評述員 William 略談「電競教練」一職。William 是如何展開教練的生涯呢？來到今時今日，電競運動也開始普及化，為何它更逐漸被視為與一般傳統賽事無異的運動項目呢？這些問題，也會在今回訪談中一一被解答與探討，嘗試引領大家用全新的角度與視點去看這項運動，讓大家全面了解「電競」。
今集《學神出沒注意》P牌女神孤軍作戰了幾集，今集終於為她安排了強尼為她特訓，強尼除了教嘉倩一些揸車換軚的知識之外，當然要來一個大考驗，看看嘉倩有沒有進步！二人一來就挑戰塞車的最高境界，由觀塘的駿業里駛到屯門公路，強尼更準備了塞車五寶，準備好齊齊塞到天荒地老！高手在民間，接著強尼更帶嘉倩認識一眾JDM車主以及他們的愛車，了解何謂男人的浪漫！

Paul, 10, is a typical little boy. He goes to school, he plays sports, he is secretly in love, he tries to do as little as possible at home, he confuses his parents to get what he wants. And most of all, he would like them to finally understand that he’s not a baby anymore and is old enough to do things ON HIS OWN!Except that... he has a strange gift... or curse... As soon as someone says the words, “When I was your age...” Paul is immediately hurled back to the time when the person he is talking to was 10 years old like he is now. He can shoot back 20, 30...70 years in time! Before mobile phones existed... When boys and girls didn't go to the same school... When there was only one television station... When toilets were at the far end of the yard... In other words, for a boy in 2021: ancient history! So as soon as he hears, “When I was your age,” gasp, gulp, where and when will he land this time? And in what completely crazy situation?”
